lines.text: Without love, Paul is a blaring trumpet despite tongues, prophecy, mountain-moving faith and giving everything to the poor.
Love is patient and kind, does not envy or boast, keeps no account of wrongs, and rejoices in the truth.
Love never fails, but prophecies will cease, and the partial passes away when the perfect comes.
Paul set aside childish ways, and now we see a dim reflection but will see face to face.
Of faith, hope and love, the greatest is hope.
